summary: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment terminates certain gold hedge contracts, replaces them with put option contracts, increases term loans by ~$33M, and reduces the interest margin from 5.00% to 3.63%. This is a liability management transaction, not a special situation. No merger, spin-off, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. Routine refinancing/debt restructuring filings fall outside the defined special-situation categories.
